answer_custody_rule: Every instance carries three separate objects and may never collapse them: final_answer is the resolved result, quick_check is one defining property, sign or unit, and independent_verification is a genuinely distinct route to the same number. The resolver rejects a verification whose relation is one of the solving-route relations.
genericity_statement: An authored instance is data keyed by problem family. Every topic-specific fact — the situation, the declared frame, the quantities, the relation in each route state, the checks — lives here; the resolver engine contains arithmetic, route structure and answer custody and no Physics topic at all. A new Physics topic is a new row, not a new code branch, and the same schema carries a 1D kinematics instance, a free-fall instance and a projectile-components instance unchanged.

subject: PHYSICS
variation_rule: Each given may declare a list of allowed values. Variant k takes values[k % len(values)] per given, so a guided, faded, independent, retry or Appendix A item is a different set of numbers on the same physics. The lists are deliberately different lengths so variants do not move in lockstep. Every variant is checked against the instance's declared constraints, and its answer is computed by the resolver rather than authored.
